ValidationRule.description: Enterprise deals must carry at least one price-book line before the stage moves into Propose, Negotiate or Closed Won (Q11, Q15). Reads the platform-maintained read-only boolean HasOpportunityLineItem rather than a roll-up, formula field or trigger (admin/products-and-pricebooks Gotcha 8). NOT(ISNEW()) and ISCHANGED(StageName) are load-bearing, not boilerplate: the field is false during the Opportunity's own insert, and without the transition guard every later save of a product-less deal already at Propose is rejected (Gotcha 15, Q16). Closed Lost deliberately out of scope. Bypass: Bypass_Opportunity_Sales_Validation, granted by Sales_Ops_Validation_Bypass (Q13, D3). Forward gate only - it does not catch deletion of the last line item; see deploy-order.md.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Opportunity_Sales_Validation), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Enterprise", NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Propose"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Negotiate"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won") ), NOT(HasOpportunityLineItem) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Add at least one product before moving this opportunity to Propose.
